checked.comment: Example 1: 2d-dim Gaussian prior, Gaussian noise N(0,tau^2), action sets fixed in advance and time-varying; Bayesian prior assumption correct.
Example 2: fixed action set {0,A',A}, mean-shifted Gaussian prior.
General linear bandit with changing compact action sets, ||A||<=a; rho from Abbasi-Yadkori uses sigma and the parameter bound.
Theorem 3.1 matches: Bayesian regret <= O~(rho iota sqrt(dT)/p) under the optimism condition.
Proposition 3.1 matches; lower bound specific to LinTS without inflation.
Proposition 3.2 item 5: Omega(T sqrt d) for T <= exp(Omega(d)).
Corollary 3.2 matches, including the correlated-prior variant.
Theorem 4.1 (informal): O~(iota d sqrt T) + 2*sum of thinness indicators, probability 1-3/T.
Theorem 9.1 expression and probability 1-3/T match; ArmBound mapped to L_feat correctly.
Corollary 9.1 matches, with Phi(-1) in the denominator.
